notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Peregrine Drake, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
